name: Zone 2 + 20 min tempo
description: Aerobic ride with one steady 20-minute tempo block at 80% FTP. Garmin only updates cycling VO2max after a steady effort of 20+ minutes, so keep the tempo block smooth and record the ride on the FR970 with the KICKR as power meter.

steps.label: Steady tempo
steps.text: Smooth and steady: this is the block Garmin reads
